blocks.text: Hi Everyone!
Time again for another Hotfix Central thread to keep you all up to date on things going on outside of the normal patch cycle in SC Alpha 4.10.2 LIVE!
This will be a living document of all the hotfixes applied to the current LIVE environment, along with dates as a timeline and when the HOTFIX channel is open and closed.

► 10.14.2026: DGS Hotfix 12939222 - Canaried onto multiple shards for testing
This DGS side hotfix contains multiple server crash fixes along with a fix for the RSI Discovery Event total score is not adding up correctly
► 10.13.2026: Hotfix 12913470 - Now on the LIVE channel
12913470 DGS fully rolled out LIVE to fix a critical hybrid-crash
12913470 Client on HOTFIX channel overnight for testing that fixes a high impact HDR client crash
► 9.8.2026: Client Hotfix 12572603 - Client side now on LIVE
This client side hotfix helps with one of the top client crashes happening with Vulkan on the latest Nvidia drivers.
► 9.2.2026: Client/DGS/Service Hotfix 12568521 - Client side now on LIVE
Today's hotfix in testing covers client, server, and service updates and fixes including:
Client: D-pad navigation fix (should help with macros/voice attack)
Server: Fix for vehicles with an expired idle timer impounding again seconds after retrieval
Server: Mendo Ren sliding off railing in SoO
Service: Fixes for Story 2 and 3 Battaglia contracts not creating properly
► 8.28.2026: Hotfix 12545750 now on LIVE
Client Side Fix for Super Heavy Combat Armor Sound Effects Playing after Unequiping
https://issue-council.robertsspaceindustries.com/projects/STAR-CITIZEN/issues/STARC-213441
Hybrid Side updates for multiple top crashes will be rolling out over time tonight and throughout the weekend to help with the most hit stability issues.
► 8.27.2026: Hotfix 12535871  is now on the HOTFIX channel and select shards on LIVE

This client and server hotfix for the LIVE environment includes fixes for audio thread framerate issues (linux), water shading and buffer issues with ships, upscaling issues for holographics, super heavy armor cannot be unequipped to local inventory, Mendo Ren falling off the balcony during encounter as well as taking damage from the world and dying randomly after teleport, and further client and server crash and stability fixes.
Teams also have ongoing investigations for the current long interaction delays with many systems in the game and we will update once we have more news.
Using the HOTFIX channel

The HOTFIX channel will become available for periods of time when the client-side of the game needs the hotfix. This channel will point to the LIVE environment and using this will retain and add progress to your LIVE account as if you were playing normally.

The best way to play on the HOTFIX channel, when one is available, is to rename your LIVE folder to HOTFIX and verify using the HOTFIX channel on the launcher. Reverse this process to go back to LIVE once it is released or you would like to stop using this channel.
